name: Are gas leak detectors reliable, and should I install one?

mainEntity.name: Are gas leak detectors reliable, and should I install one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Residential gas leak detectors can provide an early warning system for leaks, complementing your natural senses. While they are a valuable tool, they should not replace professional inspections or immediate action if you suspect a leak. Consider installing a detector in areas with gas appliances, ensuring it meets safety standards. However, if you smell gas or hear a hiss, evacuate first, then rely on a professional assessment from CG Plumbing Solutions, as detectors may not always pick up every type or size of leak.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gas leak detectors can offer early warnings but don't replace professional inspections or immediate action if you suspect a leak. They are a valuable supplement to safety measures.
